rootOnly: Access reviews and evidence packs are available to root accounts only.

review.title: Access reviews
review.description: A review lists every user, team membership, API token and environment grant with when it was last active. Mark each row keep or revoke. Revocations apply when you complete the review and are written to the audit log.
review.name: Name (optional)
review.repeatDays: Repeat every days (0 for on demand)
review.empty: No access reviews yet. Start one to record who still needs access.
review.confirmDescription: {{count}} access grant(s) will be revoked now. This cannot be undone from here.
review.partial: {{count}} revocation(s) failed, the review stays open

packs.title: Evidence packs
packs.description: A signed archive for a date range: audit log, access reviews, backup and restore test history, deploy approvals, security settings and certificate inventory, with a manifest of SHA-256 hashes.
packs.notCertification: An evidence pack is a record for an auditor to examine. It is not a certification or proof of compliance with any framework.
packs.verifyOk: Pack matches its manifest and signature
